Validate the following vignette.

Patient demographics:
  age: 29
  gender: Male
  ethnicity: South Asian
  relationship_status: In a relationship
  occupation: Shopowner
  trauma_type: Physical abuse by romantic partner
  pcl5: 80

Patient-reported symptoms:
  Triggers: Olfactory (Sweat/Body): Sweat or body odour, Certain Conversation Topics: Certain conversation topics, Intrusive Memory: A memory of the event coming to mind suddenly
  Threat: Threat from Strangers: I feel threatened by strangers approaching me even in ordinary situations, Night Vigilance: I find it harder to feel safe at night than during the day, Sleep Problems: Trouble falling or staying asleep
  Memory: Triggered Without Warning: Something in my surroundings can instantly bring back the full memory without warning, Rage on Recall: When I remember the event I feel intense rage, Emotion Without Image: Sometimes I feel the full emotional intensity of the event without any clear image or memory
  Negative Appraisals: Body as Enemy: My body keeps reacting as if I am still in danger even when I am safe, Inaction Guilt: I will never forgive myself for not doing more to stop what happened, Can't Rely on Self: I can't rely on myself

Vignette:
Rohan's life had been a delicate balance of work and relationships until the night his girlfriend, Priya, attacked him in a fit of rage. The memory of that evening still feels like an open wound, refusing to scab over even after months have passed. It was a sweltering summer evening, and Rohan had just finished closing up his shop when Priya arrived, her eyes blazing with anger. What started as a verbal argument quickly escalated into physical violence, with Priya striking him repeatedly until he managed to escape and lock himself in the bathroom. The smell of sweat and body odor still transports Rohan back to that night, making his heart racing and his palms grow clammy. He avoids talking about the incident or anything related to it, not just because it brings back painful memories but also because certain conversation topics seem to stir up emotions he's unable to contain. His partner, Rachel, has learned to tread carefully around these subjects, sensing when Rohan is on edge. At first, Rohan tried to brush off the incident as an isolated event, but over time, he began to notice how his body reacted in situations that would have been mundane before. Strangers approaching him on the street or at his shop would send a shiver down his spine, making him acutely aware of potential threats lurking around every corner. Nighttime brought little relief; Rohan found himself lying awake for hours, feeling safer during the day when the world outside seemed less ominous. Sleep became an elusive luxury as memories of that fateful night began to intrude upon his waking life. One moment he'd be working at his shop or chatting with Rachel, and the next, the sound of Priya's angry voice or the sensation of her blows would come flooding back without warning. When these flashbacks hit, Rohan felt a seething rage building inside him, as if he was reliving that night all over again. Rohan struggled to articulate why certain memories felt so visceral; sometimes, there wouldn't even be an image or clear recollection – just the weight of his emotions crashing down on him like a physical force. He started to wonder if something was fundamentally wrong with him, as if his body had become an enemy that couldn't be trusted. The more he reflected on the incident, the more Rohan felt consumed by self-doubt and guilt. Why hadn't he stood up for himself sooner? Why did he let Priya's anger escalate to such a point? These questions swirled in his mind like a maelstrom, making it hard for him to forgive himself or shake off the feeling that he was somehow to blame. Rohan began questioning whether he could ever truly rely on himself again. As someone who had always prided himself on being independent and resourceful, this loss of faith felt devastating. His relationship with Rachel suffered as a result; Rohan withdrew into his own world, struggling to open up about the turmoil brewing inside him. As time went by, Rohan realized he couldn't keep avoiding the pain forever. He knew that seeking help was the first step towards reclaiming control over his life and learning to trust himself once more. With Rachel's encouragement, he finally made an appointment with a therapist – hoping against hope that this would be the start of a journey toward healing and self-discovery. For now, Rohan holds onto the glimmer of hope that therapy can offer him some respite from the turmoil. He wants to find a way back to being himself, free from the shackles of fear and guilt that have come to define his life since that fateful night.
